name: SEOANALİZİN – SEO Yönetimi
author: seoanalizin

sections.description:
SEOANALİZİN is a free SEO plugin for WordPress. It puts the everyday SEO work in one place: search titles and meta descriptions, canonical URLs, XML sitemap, structured data (schema), redirects, social previews and live content checks while you write. It works with posts, pages, public custom post types and WooCommerce products (when WooCommerce is installed).

It is built with Turkish-language content in mind (for example, Turkish İ/ı handling in keyword checks and readability scoring), and works for any language.

Search appearance

  • Custom SEO title and meta description for every post, page, product, custom post type, category, tag and other public taxonomy.
  • Live Google-style search preview with desktop and mobile views.
  • Template variables such as %title%, %sitename%, %sep%, %tagline%, %excerpt%, %date%, %author%, %category%, %term% and %year%.
  • Optional automatic meta description fallback (off by default).
  • Canonical URLs, including taxonomy and post type archives.
  • Per-post robots controls: noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet and max-snippet.
  • Open Graph and Twitter Card output with image dimensions, article times, site name and locale.

Content analysis

  • Live SEO content check while you edit, with a score and a short list of what to fix first.
  • Focus keyword checks, heading, link and image ALT checks.
  • Readability analysis with sentence length, paragraph length, passive voice and transition word checks, tuned for Turkish text.
  • Local site health score on the dashboard, calculated on your own site. It is not a Google ranking.

Technical SEO

  • XML sitemap using the WordPress core sitemap, with an optional /sitemap.xml alias and robots.txt controls.
  • JSON-LD structured data: WebPage, Article, BreadcrumbList, ImageObject, CollectionPage, plus organization / site identity, and optional breadcrumbs.
  • Redirect manager: 301, 302, 307, 410 and 451, CSV import and export, redirect-loop protection and an optional 404 monitor with a “redirect this” shortcut.
  • Crawl cleanup options and content-type / taxonomy SEO settings.
  • Optional IndexNow notifications and an optional llms.txt file.

Migration and bulk tools

  • Importer for Yoast SEO, Rank Math and SEOPress data (titles, descriptions, canonical, robots flags, focus keywords, template variables). It fills empty fields and does not delete the original plugin’s records.
  • Bulk SEO editor for titles and descriptions.
  • SEO Data Optimization: refreshes saved SEO and readability analysis for existing content in safe batches, with progress reporting.

Free analysis service and extras

  • Optional shortcut to the free SEOANALİZİN website analysis at seoanalizin.com. A stored analysis score can be fetched into your dashboard only when you press the button (see External services below).
  • Shortcuts for Google Site Kit setup and the SEOANALİZİN Chrome extension.

Türkçe özet

SEOANALİZİN, WordPress için ücretsiz bir SEO eklentisidir: SEO başlığı ve meta açıklama, canonical, XML site haritası, schema, 301 yönlendirme, okunabilirlik ve canlı içerik kontrolü, Yoast / Rank Math / SEOPress içe aktarma. Türkçe içerik için optimize edilmiştir.

Important

Some advanced controls affect indexing and redirects. Back up the database before changing these settings. The plugin does not promise rankings, AI visibility or Google indexing.

SEOANALİZİN does not require a paid API to use its local SEO settings. IndexNow notifications require opt-in; opening the external SEO analysis tools is a separate user action. Google Site Kit is an optional third-party WordPress plugin and its account connections are handled by Site Kit.

External services

IndexNow

IndexNow is an optional third-party URL notification service. It is disabled by default and is used only after a site administrator explicitly enables IndexNow in SEOANALİZİN.

When enabled, the plugin sends HTTPS requests to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow to notify participating search engines that an eligible public URL on the WordPress site has been added or updated. Each request contains the site’s public hostname, the public URL being submitted, the generated IndexNow key, and the public URL of the IndexNow key verification file. Like other HTTPS requests, the remote service can also receive the requesting server’s IP address as part of the connection.

Manual requests are sent only when an administrator uses the IndexNow submit action. Automatic requests are sent only when both IndexNow and automatic notifications are enabled and an eligible published URL changes. The integration does not send post body content, private content, WordPress usernames, email addresses, passwords, or analytics data.

IndexNow Terms of Service: https://www.indexnow.org/terms
IndexNow privacy information (Privacy section): https://www.indexnow.org/terms#privacy

SEOANALİZİN analysis service (seoanalizin.com)

The dashboard has an optional card that shows the result of an SEO analysis of your site that was already run on seoanalizin.com. Nothing is requested automatically: a request is made only when an administrator presses the “Skoru seoanalizin.com’dan getir” (fetch score) button.

When the button is pressed, the plugin sends one HTTPS GET request to https://seoanalizin.com/api/wp-score.php containing only the site’s public hostname (for example example.com). The service answers with the latest stored analysis for that hostname (overall and category scores and a short list of findings), which is stored in a WordPress option on your site. The request never starts a crawl, and it is not sent for localhost, IP addresses or .local/.test hosts. Like any HTTPS request, the service can also receive the requesting server’s IP address. The “Yeni analiz başlat” button only opens seoanalizin.com in a new tab.

SEOANALİZİN terms of use: https://seoanalizin.com/kullanim-kosullari
SEOANALİZİN privacy policy: https://seoanalizin.com/gizlilik
sections.installation:
1. Back up your WordPress files and database.
  2. Upload the SEOANALİZİN plugin through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin (or place the folder in wp-content/plugins).
  3. Activate the plugin and open SEOANALİZİN > Genel, then run the first-time setup.
  4. Configure SEO title, description and site identity in the settings screens.
  5. Verify a published page’s HTML source for the title, meta description and canonical URL.
  6. Test the XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml (also available at /wp-sitemap.xml) and confirm robots.txt as needed.

If Yoast SEO, Rank Math or another supported SEO plugin is active, overlapping public SEO outputs are disabled to reduce duplicates. Import existing metadata with a database backup before switching to SEOANALİZİN as the active SEO plugin. Do not run two SEO plugins generating identical SEO output on the same site.
sections.faq:
Which language is the plugin interface in?

The admin screens are currently in Turkish, and the plugin is designed for Turkish content first. SEO output on your site (titles, meta tags, sitemap, schema) works with any language. Translations can be contributed on translate.wordpress.org.

Does it work with WooCommerce and custom post types?

Yes. SEO fields are available for WooCommerce products (when WooCommerce is installed) and for every public custom post type. Use the seoanalizin_post_types filter to adjust the list.

Can I switch from Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress?

Yes. The built-in importer reads titles, descriptions, canonical, robots flags and focus keywords and fills empty SEOANALİZİN fields without deleting the original plugin’s data. Back up your database first and check a few pages before deactivating the old plugin.

Does it create an XML sitemap?

Yes. It uses the WordPress core sitemap (/wp-sitemap.xml) and can expose an optional /sitemap.xml alias. Posts and terms set to noindex are left out.

Does it manage 301 redirects?

Yes. The redirect manager supports 301, 302, 307, 410 and 451, CSV import and export, loop protection and an optional 404 monitor.

Does the plugin send my content to SEOANALİZİN automatically?

No. The local SEO optimizer and editor checks run within your WordPress installation. The optional external SEO analyzer/crawler links open separately when clicked. If you initiate an analysis there, the destination site is handled under that service’s terms and privacy policy. Optional IndexNow sends the applicable public URL to api.indexnow.org only when enabled.

Is this plugin affiliated with Yoast?

No. Yoast is a separate third-party plugin. The optional importer reads supported existing metadata but does not delete Yoast data.

Does uninstalling delete my SEO data?

No. Deleting the plugin removes only temporary data (404 log, import progress, locks). Your SEO titles, descriptions, settings and redirects stay in the database so they are not lost if you reinstall.

Will the plugin change my site’s visible header/logo?

No. The site identity fields mainly affect SEO metadata and structured data. Visible theme branding is controlled by the WordPress theme.

Does the plugin replace WordPress XML sitemaps?

No. The built-in /wp-sitemap.xml is the canonical core endpoint. SEOANALİZİN can expose an optional /sitemap.xml alias to that same core sitemap if the site permalink rules support it. This does not change a staging site’s noindex setting.

Does Google Site Kit send data to SEOANALİZİN automatically?

No. Site Kit setup is separate and Google authorization is handled by Site Kit itself.

Can I use it on a localhost XAMPP installation?

Yes for local settings and output testing. External SEO crawlers and some Google service connections require a publicly accessible site.

Is the migration destructive?

The importer (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress) is designed to fill supported empty fields without deleting the original plugin’s records. Back up your database and test the migrated pages before switching plugins.
sections.changelog:
3.6.3

  • New: the plugin now adds a small HTML comment to the page source so SEO analysis tools can detect it.

3.6.2

  • Fixed: on a static front page the “Ana sayfa” title and description settings were ignored; they now fill any field left blank on the page itself.
  • Fixed: Turkish capital İ / I and dotless ı now match lowercase spellings in focus keyword checks (editor and saved scores).
  • New: SEO title, meta description and index/noindex fields for categories, tags, product categories and other public taxonomies. Term noindex also removes the term from the XML sitemap.
  • New: SEO fields for every public custom post type (filter: seoanalizin_post_types), not only post, page and product. Bulk editor, reports, link analysis, scores and sitemap options follow the same list.
  • New: template variables (%title%, %sitename%, %sep%, %tagline%, %excerpt%, %date%, %author%, %category%, %term%, %year%) in the per-post and per-term title, description and social fields.
  • New: optional automatic meta description fallback (from the excerpt or content, off by default; enable in the settings).
  • New: nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet and max-snippet controls per post; robots output goes through the WordPress wp_robots filter.
  • New: canonical URLs for taxonomy and post type archives; full Open Graph and Twitter Card output (image dimensions, article times, site name, locale).
  • Improved: JSON-LD graph with WebPage, ImageObject, BreadcrumbList, Article (with Person author) and CollectionPage nodes.
  • New: redirect types 301, 302, 307, 410 and 451, CSV export, bulk text import, redirect-loop protection and a throttled, opt-in 404 monitor with one-click “redirect this”. Existing 3.6.1 redirects are migrated automatically.
  • New: importer for Rank Math and SEOPress in addition to Yoast SEO, including category/tag data, robots flags and template-variable conversion.
  • Added uninstall cleanup of temporary data only; SEO content and settings are kept.
  • New: local site health score (0-100) on the dashboard, calculated on the site from basic SEO settings and the share of posts and pages with SEO fields filled in. No data is sent anywhere and it is not a Google ranking. The checks are a collapsible list; each failing check links to the setting that fixes it.
  • New: optional dashboard card that fetches the latest seoanalizin.com analysis (score, category scores, top findings) for the site. It only runs when an administrator presses the button, sends only the public hostname and is documented under External services. Findings link to the setting that can fix them.
  • Changed: the admin menu lists Genel, Ayarlar, Site özellikleri, SEO Durum Raporu, Tarama & İndeksleme and Bağlantı Analizi. First-time configuration, Task list, Alert center, SEO Data Optimization and the importer open from the in-page panel; those screens stay registered, so direct links and permissions keep working.
  • Changed: the dashboard shows the health and seoanalizin.com cards first, then the Google Site Kit and Chrome extension cards. The product analysis card appears only when a product post type exists.
  • Fixed: “Site türü” on the first-time screen now also updates the organization identity used by the structured data.
  • Fixed: on the Bulk SEO editor the SEO title field gets the plugin’s styling and the “saved” notice stays below the header.
  • Fixed: in the editor readability panel, “Cümle uzunluğu” and “Paragraf uzunluğu” showed warnings for empty or very short texts (under 150 words), which are not scored; they now stay neutral like the other checks.
  • Fixed: the dashboard button said “Yoast verilerini aktar” although the importer also supports Rank Math and SEOPress.
  • Fixed: Plugin Check findings (escaped select output on term screens, integer HTTP status for removed pages, sanitized source parameters, no explicit file close on the CSV download stream).

3.6.1

  • Sanitized the Site Features request array at input time to satisfy WordPress security validation.
  • Marked the Google Site Kit setup filter as an intentional third-party hook so WordPress coding checks do not treat its external hook name as an unprefixed plugin hook.

3.6.0

  • Updated WordPress.org directory compliance: enqueued admin CSS/JS, hardened request handling, and aligned the translation text domain with the assigned plugin slug.
  • Expanded unique SEOANALİZİN prefixes for plugin classes, hooks, stored settings, transients, shortcodes, and admin actions while preserving compatible reads of legacy 3.5.9 data.
  • Documented the optional IndexNow external service, including transmitted data, activation conditions, terms, and privacy information.

3.5.9

  • Added batched SEO Data Optimization for refreshing saved post, page, and product analysis caches.
  • Added progress reporting, resume and repeat-scan support. Existing SEO titles, descriptions, focus keywords and other settings remain unchanged.

3.5.8

  • Refined Turkish readability scoring so an insufficient heading structure is not always marked 100/100.

3.5.7

  • Improved 301 redirect form validation, including same-site full source URLs and readable notices.

3.5.6

  • Kept the friendly /sitemap.xml URL while serving the WordPress core XML sitemap internally.
  • Refreshed sitemap rewrite rules once on administrator access.
  • Left canonical links, robots/noindex, other redirects and SEO features unchanged.

3.5.5

  • Added a /sitemap.xml alias using the existing WordPress XML sitemap index.
  • Allowed administrators to preview the sitemap on noindex test sites while retaining the WordPress noindex setting.
  • Preserved canonical URL output as a rel=canonical link (not a meta tag).
  • Updated robots.txt sitemap address for public sites and installed rewrite rules once.

3.5.1

  • Reordered the general dashboard welcome card and integrations.

3.5.0

  • Updated version/readme consistency for release-candidate testing.
  • Added plugin-list documentation, support, and Chrome extension links.
  • Clarified the setup workflow and testing limitations.

3.4.x

  • Expanded advanced settings, admin layouts, SEO tools cards, Site Kit setup shortcuts, and plugin-list settings access.

3.3.x

  • Added Gutenberg metadata saving, robots.txt settings, WordPress sitemap integration, optional IndexNow, and Yoast migration tools.
